
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the KMeans distance metric string associated with a KMeans
    distance metric enumeration constant.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: integer
        Distance metric enumeration constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Distance metric string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/ml/cluster/base/kmeans/metric-str2enum}}( 'euclidean' ) )
    'euclidean'

    --------
